name: Kimi Research Assistant
tag: Searches the web, reads your documents and keeps the findings in threads your team can share.

scenarios.title: Size a new market
scenarios.ask: Research the market for commercial kitchen cleaning in our region. Read {sources} web sources and our {docs} internal reports.
steps: Web search
Ran {=ceil(sources / 4)} searches and read {sources} pages on pricing, demand and local rules.
Document reader
Pulled past quotes and win rates from {docs} internal reports.
Analyst
Built a simple estimate: restaurants times visits per year times average price.
Citation keeper
Linked every number in the summary to the page or file it came from.
Thread
Saved the work in a shared thread so your team can ask follow-ups.
followups: It is a rough top-down number built from the assumptions shown. Change any assumption and the thread recalculates, and each one links to its source.
Can my team add to the thread?
Yes. Anyone in the thread can ask a follow-up or upload a file, and the assistant answers with the full history in view.

scenarios.title: Compare software vendors
scenarios.ask: Compare {vendors} payroll software vendors for a {staff}-person company. Focus on cost and setup time.
steps: Web search
Found pricing pages, help docs and recent reviews for each of the {vendors} vendors.
Reader
Pulled base fees, per-employee fees and setup steps into one table.
Analyst
Calculated a sample yearly cost for {staff} employees using each vendor's listed pricing.
Writer
Summarized pros and cons and flagged {=max(1, vendors - 2)} vendors whose pricing needs a sales call to confirm.
followups: They are taken from the pages the assistant read today, with links and the date. Vendors change prices, so confirm before you sign.
Can it email the vendors for us?
It can draft the questions to send. A person sends them.

scenarios.title: Summarize a long report
scenarios.ask: Summarize this {pages}-page industry report in {length} for our leadership team.
steps: Document reader
Read all {pages} pages, including tables and charts.
Outliner
Found {=max(3, round(pages / 25))} main sections and their key numbers.
Writer
Wrote a summary of about {=length * 120} words with page references.
Checker
Compared each number in the summary with the source page.
followups: What if a chart is the key point?
The reader extracts the numbers behind charts when possible and notes the page so you can check the original.
Can I ask questions about the report later?
Yes. The report stays in the thread, so anyone can ask about a section and get an answer with the page number.
